chapter: Ella, Charlie Christian and Europe with Hayes
title: Leaving the Ella band to return to Minton's
summary: With Barefield and Dizzy gone and the band too old and falling apart, he went back to Minton's; Garvin Bushell is praised in passing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, now, how long did you -- you didn't stay with the band long, did you?
No, I didn't stay with the band long. I went back to Minton's.
Why didn't you stay with the band?
Let's see, now. What did happen? Well, Eddie Barefield left. And Diz went with Cab.
Went with who? Cab.
Cab Calloway. So I said, well -- because I'm not going to stay in the band alone, you know.
No.
So I left and -- Tommy was a very good -- I loved Tommy Fuld very much. I liked him very much.
A kind of gentle guy, isn't he?
Uh-huh. But I left the band because they were too old, you know?
Yeah, I know.
It was Chauncey Horton and --
Yeah, it was all falling apart.
Yeah. Chauncey was a nice guy. He was a wonderful guy. But I just couldn't stay because, you know, I didn't figure I would be progressing, you know.
Yeah.
Getting anywhere.
But there was Waymon Carver and Chauncey.
That's right.
They were the guys that did the flute things.
Uh-huh.
Yeah. Right.
And so I left. And Eddie Barefield left, so I left anyway.
Yeah.
And I went back to Minton's.
Garvin Bushell, he was a nice guy.
Yeah. Bushell. Beautiful.
Yeah.
Yeah, he was one of my favorite people.
Yeah, a nice guy.
